title: Mighty Paw Naturals Bully Sticks: Remy's Test Notes
description: Remy tested Mighty Paw Naturals 12-inch bully sticks. Here is why these single-ingredient, lower-odor beef chews became one of his favorite treats.
card_summary: Remy knows the sound of the bag. Single-ingredient beef chews with less odor than other bully sticks we have tried.
lede: The second we open this bag, Remy knows exactly what is happening. These 12-inch bully sticks are one of his favorite chews, and they have noticeably less odor than other bully sticks we have tried.
verdict_text: Simple ingredient list, less odor than the other bully sticks we have tried, and Remy is fully locked in as soon as he hears the bag open.

surfaces.name: The bag test
surfaces.note: Remy recognizes the sound of this bag immediately and comes running. That is usually a strong sign.

surfaces.name: Ingredient check
surfaces.note: The Amazon listing identifies one ingredient: beef pizzle. No complicated ingredient list to decode.

surfaces.name: Odor check
surfaces.note: Still a bully stick, but noticeably less smelly than other bully sticks we have used.

what_we_tested:
We have given Remy the 12-inch Mighty Paw Naturals bully sticks as a chew when he needs something he is actually excited to settle down with. The main test is pretty simple: does he want it, does it hold his attention, and does the smell take over the room?

These passed all three. Remy knows the sound of the bag as soon as we open it, and he is immediately ready for one.
what_worked:
The biggest win is how simple they are. The listing identifies a **single ingredient: beef pizzle**. Mighty Paw also describes the sticks as grass-fed beef chews with no added flavors or artificial preservatives.

They are also noticeably lower odor than other bully sticks we have tried. Lower odor does not mean zero odor, but the difference is real enough that we keep reaching for these instead of the other bags.
what_didnt_work: Nothing major in our testing. They are still bully sticks, so there is some smell and they are not a quick little training treat. As with any chew, we supervise Remy and take away the small end when it is time.
remys_take: Remy's review is not subtle. The second this bag opens, he is interested. He loves these and does not need any convincing.
worth_buying: Yes. We recommend these highly if your dog likes bully sticks and you want a simple single-ingredient chew that smells less intense than a lot of the alternatives. We use the 12-inch sticks for Remy.

faqs.question: What size Mighty Paw bully sticks did Remy test?
faqs.answer: We use the 12-inch Mighty Paw Naturals bully sticks. The linked Amazon listing is the 12-inch, 10-pack option.

faqs.answer: The Amazon listing identifies one ingredient: beef pizzle.

faqs.question: Do Mighty Paw bully sticks smell?
faqs.answer: They still have some bully-stick odor, but we found them noticeably less smelly than other bully sticks we have tried.

faqs.question: Does Remy like them?
faqs.answer: Yes. Remy recognizes the sound of the bag immediately and gets excited as soon as we open it.

faqs.answer: Yes. We supervise Remy with chews and take away the small end when it is time.
